whatChangedFromV2: THE MANDATE MODE IS NO LONGER DECLARED BY ANYONE. `grantMandate` takes ONE argument (the session) instead of two; the policy envelope is `abi.encode(string chain, bytes body)` instead of `abi.encode(uint8 mode, bytes body)`; and the wallet and URP each DERIVE the mode from that one chain string, independently, from byte-identical input. A universal grant additionally verifies the declared chain against the asset's own `SOURCE_CHAIN_NAMESPACE()` - the same view the gateway reads on every outbound to decide routing - so the chain is enforced rather than merely recorded. Every address below is new; v2 mandates do not carry over.

factoryProxy.note: THE USER-FACING ADDRESS. Every integration points here. Permanent: the wallet salt derivation and the 40-byte immutable-args encoding are frozen forever, because counterfactual funding is a supported flow with no recovery path.
liveChecks: deployWallet("smoke-v3") deployed a real clone; walletCount(deployer) -> 1

factoryLogic.note: UUPS implementation. Never called directly. Unchanged in source from v2 - redeployed only because the wallet implementation it points at changed.

walletImplementation.note: Clone template. Every wallet is a minimal clone of this with 40 bytes of immutable args (owner 0-19, factory 20-39). NEW IN v3.2: `grantMandate(Session)` - one argument, no MandateType; the mode is derived from the chain each action's policy envelope declares, and every action must declare the same chain (`InconsistentChain(i)`). Its `urp` arg is the PROXY, so wallets keep working across URP upgrades. Grew 11,626 -> 12,312 B.
liveChecks: urp() -> the PROXY, not the implementation

urp.note: THE POLICY ADDRESS. Every wallet pins this; every session names it as its only action policy. The explorer resolves it as an EIP-1967 proxy and serves URP's verified source here - see README, 'Reading the verification fields'.
liveChecks: pushChainHash() -> 0x3d6bc1f1d3fb03065860265a8e93840b586e57075d956cd41b4319d040be87f9 == keccak256("eip155:42101"), computed from block.chainid, NOT configured

urpImplementation.note: The two-rulebook security boundary: sixteen gates for a cross-chain mandate, nine for a Push-side one. Which runs is decided by the mode stored at init, which was derived from the envelope's chain. NEW IN v3.2: the envelope decoder, `pushChainHash()`, and the init-time asset-chain check (`ChainMismatch` / `InvalidAsset`). Grew 12,134 -> 13,176 B. NEVER initialise this directly; its constructor disables the initialiser.

urpProxyAdmin.note: KEEP THIS ADDRESS - no URP upgrade is possible without it. TUP creates it internally and returns it nowhere; it was read from the URP proxy's ERC-1967 admin slot and confirmed live. VERIFIED THIS TIME, unlike v2: the explorer previously refused inner-CREATE contracts with is_contract:false. Owner is the deployer EOA for testnet; production should hold this in a multisig.

sessionValidator.note: Stateless signature check: secp256k1, or Ed25519 via a raw staticcall to the USV precompile. Unchanged in source from v2.

sessionEngine.note: Vendored fork 7dc20e4, adopted UNMODIFIED. Byte-identical to the v2 deployment, which is the evidence that nothing in this change disturbed the engine. 1,995 B under EIP-170 - the tightest margin in the build, and why optimizer_runs is pinned at 833.

adminState.note: Admin is the deployer EOA for testnet, matching v2. TWO DISTINCT UPGRADE AUTHORITIES exist and they are different powers: the factory's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (UUPS upgrade of factory logic - the only action that can strand counterfactually funded addresses) and the URP ProxyAdmin owner (can replace every gate in the policy). A production deployment should hold both in a multisig, and they should NOT be the same key.

smokeTest.label: smoke-v3
smokeTest.note: A real wallet deployed through the real factory, not a simulation. The deployment is not considered verified until this passes.

breakingChanges: `grantMandate` takes ONE argument. Its selector changed again; a payload built against the two-argument form misses the function entirely rather than failing a shape check.
Policy `initData` is `abi.encode(string chain, bytes body)`. A v2 `(uint8 mode, bytes)` envelope decodes to an EMPTY chain and reverts with a NAMED `EmptyChain()`; so does a bare struct.

The SDK encodes `UniversalTerms` / `NativeTerms`, not `Config` / `NativeConfig`. Seven fields URP owns (`initialized`, `spent`, `destChainHash`, `valueSpent`, `amountSpent`, `callsUsed`) are no longer typed by the caller.
`Config.destChainHash` keeps slot 1 and is NEVER written. A mandate's chain is `getMode(id, account).chainHash`.
`MandateGranted` gained two fields: the chain hash (indexed) and the chain string.
